image_depicts: Main building of the Tallinn University (TLU) Academic Library, Ravala pst 10, Tallinn
notes: AUDIT_FAIL_MARKETING_BANNER_REPLACED: existing DB campus.webp was a marketing/slogan banner ('TARGA ELUVIISI EESTVEDAJA!') composited over a building photo with a TALLINNA ULIKOOL logo lockup at the bottom - dominant text+logo. IMPORTANT name-collision note: Tallinn University (TLU) is a DIFFERENT institution from Tallinn University of Technology (TalTech) - picked a source explicitly captioned 'Tallinn University (TLU)' to avoid conflating the two.
review_notes: Investigated a real identity question I found on inspection: the building's visible entrance signage reads 'TEADUSTE AKADEEMIA' (Estonian Academy of Sciences), not Tallinn University. Resolved via web research: the building at Ravala pst 10, Tallinn was the Estonian SSR Academy of Sciences Central Library from 1966, but has operated as Tallinn University's (TLU) Academic Library since 2003 and still carries its heritage signage. The Commons file page (CC BY-SA 2.5 confirmed) independently corroborates this: 'main building of the Tallinn University (TLU) Academic Library, Ravala pst 10, Tallinn, Estonia.' Not a mismatch -- correctly identified, just an unusual heritage-building situation worth documenting so a future reviewer doesn't re-flag it.

image_depicts: Beytepe Campus, Hacettepe University, Ankara
notes: Fresh source (no existing DB photo).
review_notes: The chosen frame shows only a tree, a birdhouse, and a sliver of wall -- no campus architecture is visible at all. Checked the Commons file page and its own structured data literally tags the subject as 'nest box' and 'tree.' The source is genuinely from the right series (category 'May 2023 at Beytepe Campus,' Hacettepe University Beytepe Campus, CC BY 4.0 confirmed -- so correct_university_verified and the license are not in question), but this specific photo fails to depict the institution as a place at all, which is the same failure mode the original researcher itself used to reject other records (e.g. SUSTech's 'unreadable/generic street-intersection scene'). The category has 173 numbered photos from the same shoot; I tried several plausible low-numbered filenames (001/010/020/030/050) via Special:FilePath hoping to find a building shot to substitute, but none resolved (the sequence numbering isn't simply zero-padded low integers) and I did not want to keep guessing indefinitely. Recommend a future pass browse the category directly (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:May_2023_at_Beytepe_Campus) and pick a frame that actually shows a building -- the license work for that whole series is already done. Pulled out of VERIFIED into CANDIDATE pending that swap; rights_status/license fields left untouched since the license itself is genuinely fine.
